## Read before submitting

> **Kernels in this repository are community kernels.** They are reviewed by AMD
> maintainers for policy and safety, built and tested on AMD GPUs by CI, and published
> to the Hugging Face Hub on request, but they are **not supported by AMD**. See
> [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
> [docs/COMMUNITY_POLICY.md](../docs/COMMUNITY_POLICY.md).
>
> We cannot accept:
>
> - AITER code, or kernels named `aiter-*` or published to `amd/*`. Changes to AMD's
>   kernels go to [ROCm/aiter](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter).
> - Build outputs (`build/`, `result*`, `*.so`).
>
> New kernels: please open an issue first, so we can agree it fits before you spend
> time on packaging.

Title format: `<kernel>: short description`, for example `my-kernel: add fp8 path`.
